why: RJ-F12 (flare/lottie-open LO-5): on since LO-5 opened .json through FlareLottieOpen and added import.report; the job runs import.report first (refused unless the document came from a Lottie: it proves the open). Opens bounce.json (a ball shape layer with three position keys over a solid floor), sets the ball's fill to orange and exports Lottie. The input's bytes must be unchanged (Save never targets the JSON); LO-5 pins the exported file's keyframe count and fill colour: its sha256, checked by hand to hold the ball's three position keys (frames 0, 24 and 47) and fl.c [1, 0.5, 0, 1].
